product.ta-21-fde.summary: The TA 21/FDE brought diskette storage to TA 21 data entry.
product.ta-21-fde.history: Triumph-Adler offered it alongside the cassette-based TA 21/MBKE. The model sheet distinguishes the two factory configurations.
product.ta-21-fde.technical.configuratio: The diskette stored the data collected at the workstation. The model sheet identifies the FDE drive as IBM-compatible and pairs it with 8 KiB of RAM.
product.ta-21-fde.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-21-fde.technical.limitations: Firmware from an identified unit and program media are still needed to check operation.
